// ================== BENGALI VOICE FUNCTION ==================
const tts = require('google-translate-tts');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

async function sendBengaliVoice(api, threadID, text) {
    if (!text) return;

    try {
        const audioBuffer = await tts.synthesize({
            text: text,
            voice: 'bn',        // Bengali voice
            speed: 1.05
        });

        const fileName = `voice_${Date.now()}.mp3`;
        const filePath = path.join(__dirname, fileName);

        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, audioBuffer);

        const msg = {
            body: "",
            attachment: fs.createReadStream(filePath)
        };

        api.sendMessage(msg, threadID, (err) => {
            if (err) console.error(err);
            
            // ১০ সেকেন্ড পর ফাইল ডিলিট
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
            }, 10000);
        });

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Bengali TTS Error:", error);
        // যদি voice না হয় তাহলে সাধারণ টেক্সট পাঠাবে
        api.sendMessage(text, threadID);
    }
}
